# Preemptive

`customer_support.pb.escalation_management.preemptive` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Escalate ahead of a known bad milestone — before the entitlement clock runs out, before a renewal conversation, before the customer's own internal deadline — rather than at the moment of failure.

Escalating before the breach is a plan; escalating after it is a report. The receiver has options in the first case and only apologies in the second, and the customer can tell which one they got.
